commands_used: answer 1. I was freed from the Owing by Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa. She secretly serves the Toh-Reel-Ka, Secret Warriors of the Xeech-Leel, who try to prevent another Umbriel-type disaster. Jal-Veesa Hist is dying and trees along the river are sick; nobody knows why. 2. Go to Vosh-Leera at her house in Jal-Veesa and ask for her second task. 3. I can accept her task, ask questions first, or refuse; I can also ask Weeltul about sap, scar and Umbriel. I mean to resolve things in a comforting way. 4. I do not know why the trees are sick, what the second task is, or fully what the Toh-Reel-Ka want. I can find out by asking Vosh-Leera and Weeltul.

answer 1. Vosh-Leera gave me a cup of Hist sap from before the scar closed. Drinking it lets me ask the trees, which are joined at the root, where the sickness is. She works for the Toh-Reel-Ka and wants me to report what I see. 2. Drink the sap here in front of Vosh-Leera and ask where the sickness is, then tell her everything I see. 3. I can drink it now, first ask Weeltul about sap, or refuse. I do not know the risks of drinking it. 4. I do not know what drinking sap will do to me or whether it is safe. I could ask Weeltul about the sap before drinking.

answer 1. I drank the sap and had a vision: a young Hist among stilt huts beside a woven weir, and a reed hide beside a lone dead tree. This may show where the sickness is. 2. Tell Vosh-Leera what I saw, here at Jal-Veesa. 3. I can report it fully, or hold something back; I mean to be honest and comforting. 4. I do not know where the weir, huts or dead tree are, or what they mean. Vosh-Leera or Weeltul may know.

answer 1. My vision showed Teel-Fen Weir, a Sedge-Wardens camp south of Jal-Veesa where a young Hist grew from Jal-Veesa tree roots. Someone at a reed hide beside a dead tree is keeping jars of sap, which may be linked to the sickness. I work for Vosh-Leera and the Toh-Reel-Ka. 2. Go to Teel-Fen Weir and speak to Heem-Jasa, its tree-minder, on the platform round the tree. 3. I can talk to Heem-Jasa first as Vosh-Leera advised, or go to the hide, which I was warned to be careful about. 4. I do not know who keeps the jars at the hide or why. Heem-Jasa may tell me.

answer 1. Someone is draining Hist trees of sap and sealing the scars with grey paste. Heem-Jasa found her young tree drained and sealed three nights ago. Strangers (Sap-Takers) keep jars at the reed hide west of the weir. 2. Take the note from the reed hide west of Teel-Fen Weir. 3. Fight the three Sap-Takers, shoot them from the reeds east of the hide, or sneak round the open west side to the jars and note. I prefer the least bloody way, sneaking. 4. I do not know who the Sap-Takers work for, what the grey paste is, or what the note says. The note may tell me.

answer 1. I got the note unseen. The Sap-Takers master orders them to bring jars to Karsh-Naal Camp and seal every scar behind them. So an organized group is draining Hist trees. 2. Return to Heem-Jasa at Teel-Fen Weir; she will ask whether her tree will live. 3. Tell her honestly, or comfort her; I mean to comfort her without lying about what I know. I can later go to Karsh-Naal Camp. 4. I do not know where Karsh-Naal Camp is, who the master is, or whether the tree will live.

answer 1. Someone is draining Hist trees and sealing scars with grey paste; the Sap-Takers work for a master who sends jars to Karsh-Naal Camp. I comforted Heem-Jasa that her tree will live, though I do not truly know that. 2. The quest is complete; nothing further is set. I could report to Vosh-Leera or look into Karsh-Naal Camp. 3. Go to Vosh-Leera with the note, ask Heem-Jasa about Karsh-Naal Camp, or trade with her. 4. I do not know where Karsh-Naal Camp is, who the master is, what the grey paste is, or whether the tree will live.

answer Notes: I serve Vosh-Leera of Jal-Veesa, who works for the Toh-Reel-Ka. I drank Hist sap, saw Teel-Fen Weir, and went to Heem-Jasa, minder of the young Hist there. Her tree was drained and sealed with grey paste three nights ago. At the Sap-Takers hide west of the weir I took their note: their master orders jars brought to Karsh-Naal Camp and every scar sealed. I told Heem-Jasa, as a comfort, that her tree will live; I do not truly know it. She gave me 3 Cure Poison potions and trades or teaches only with the straight. I still have about 50 gold, two lockpicks, and the note. Unknown: location of Karsh-Naal Camp, who the master is, what the grey paste is, why they take sap. Next: report to Vosh-Leera, ask Heem-Jasa about Karsh-Naal Camp, and ask Weeltul about sap, scar and Umbriel.
